CLAREMONT CITY COUNCIL
  MEETING AGENDA
  “We are a vibrant, livable, and inclusive community dedicated to quality services,
  safety, financial strength, sustainability, preservation, and progress
  with equal representation for our community.”

City Council Chamber  Tuesday
225 Second Street  April 23, 2024
Claremont, CA 91711
  6:30 PM

  COUNCILMEMBERS

  SAL MEDINA
  MAYOR

  JED LEANO  ED REECE  COREY CALAYCAY  JENNIFER STARK

Meetings are open to the public for in-person attendance. The meeting will be live streamed via Zoom,
technology permitting. Members of the public will not be able to provide public comment via Zoom. To
watch the meeting via Zoom, use the following link: https://zoom.us/j/256208090. To listen via telephone
dial (213)338-8477, Webinar ID: 256 208 090. The recorded meeting will be uploaded to the City
website and archived.

  OPTIONS FOR PUBLIC COMMENT

Public comment may be provided by one of the following methods. Each speaker will be given up to
three (3) minutes to provide their comment.

  IN-PERSON LIVE COMMENTS

When the item you wish to speak to is announced, please proceed to the speaker’s podium one by one.

  E-MAIL/MAIL

Written comments sent to the City Clerk’s office will be distributed to the City Council and imaged into
the record of the meeting. Email: sdesautels@ci.claremont.ca.us, jcostanza@ci.claremont.ca.us. Mail:
PO Box 880, Claremont, CA 91711. Written comments submitted after publication of the agenda will be
made available in the document archive system on the City website as soon as possible -
www.ci.claremont.ca.us.

  For assistance, comments, or more information please contact the City Clerk’s Office:
  (909) 399-5461 or (909) 399-5463.

Council Assignment Reports
City Councilmembers may serve as representatives on regional organizations. This time is
allocated for reports about their activities. For information about the Council's local,
intergovernmental  and  regional  appointments  please  visit  the  City website :
www.ci.claremont.ca.us/government/city-council/city-council-assignments-and-appointments.

CITY MANAGER REPORT

PUBLIC COMMENT
The Council has set aside this time for persons who wish to comment on items that are not listed
on the agenda, but are within the jurisdiction of the City Council. Members of the public will have
the opportunity to address the City Council regarding all items on the agenda at the time the
Council considers those items.

General public comment will be taken for 30 minutes and will resume later in the meeting if there
are speakers who did not get an opportunity to speak because of the 30-minute time limit.

The Brown Act prohibits the City Council from taking action on oral requests relating to items that
are not on the agenda. The Council may engage in a brief discussion, refer the matter to staff,
and/or schedule requests for consideration at a subsequent meeting.

CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed on the Consent Calendar are considered routine. The City Council may act on
these items by one motion following public comment. Only Councilmembers may pull an item from
the Consent Calendar for discussion, reading of resolutions and ordinances will be waived.
 Page 3  City Council Agenda  April 23, 2024

1.  ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING THE CITY WARRANT REGISTER
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, ALLOWING
  CERTAIN CLAIMS AND DEMANDS AND SPECIFYING THE FUNDS OUT
  OF WHICH THE SAME ARE TO BE PAID, dated April 11, 2024.
  Attachment(s):  Resolution Approving City Warrant Register Dated April 11, 2024

2.  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES OF APRIL 9, 2024 (REGULAR)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council approve the regular City Council meeting
  minutes of April 9, 2024.
  Attachment(s):  Draft Regular Meeting Minutes of April 9, 2024

3.  SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF AN ORDINANCE AMENDING CHAPTER 3.15 OF
  THE CLAREMONT MUNICIPAL CODE REGARDING PURCHASING AND BIDDING
  REGULATIONS AND THE CITY MANAGER’S PURCHASING AUTHORITY
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council waive further reading and adopt AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT,
  CALIFORNIA,  AMENDING  CHAPTER  3.15 OF  THE  CLAREMONT
  MUNICIPAL  CODE  REGARDING  PURCHASING  AND  BIDDING
  REGULATIONS AND THE CITY MANAGER'S PURCHASING AUTHORITY.
  Attachment(s):  Proposed Ordinance

4.  INVESTMENT REPORT - QUARTER ENDING MARCH 31, 2024
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council receive and accept the Investment Report
  for the quarter ending March 31, 2024.
  Attachment(s):  Quarterly Investment Report

5.  QUARTERLY FINANCIAL UPDATE - MARCH 31, 2024
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council receive and file the Quarterly Financial
  Update for the quarter ending March 31, 2024.
6.  AUTHORIZATION TO ENTER INTO A PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH
  MICHAEL BAKER INTERNATIONAL FOR THE DESIGN AND PREPARATION OF PLANS
  AND SPECIFICATIONS FOR ACCESSIBILITY IMPROVEMENTS (FUNDING SOURCE:
  MEASURE M FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council:
  A. Authorize the City Manager to enter into a professional services
  agreement with Michael Baker International in the amount of $181,700 for
  professional engineering services and authorize a 10 percent contingency in
  the amount of $18,170, for a total not to exceed contract amount of
  $199,870; and
  B. Find this item exempt from environmental review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA).
 Page 4  City Council Agenda  April 23, 2024

7.  AUTHORIZATION  TO  AMEND THE  EXISTING  AGREEMENT  WITH GARCON
  CONSTRUCTION FOR THE COLLEGE AVENUE AT GREEN STREET BIKE AND
  PEDESTRIAN IMPROVEMENTS PROJECT, CIP 2022-01, UPGRADING THE PROJECT
  RESURFACING FROM SLURRY SEAL TO RUBBERIZED ASPHALT OVERLAY (FUNDING
  SOURCE: PROPOSITION C FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council:
  A. Authorize the City Manager to amend the existing agreement with Garcon
  Construction to increase compensation by $242,000, for a total agreement
  amount of $989,054, for the College Avenue at Green Street Bike and
  Pedestrian Improvements Project;
  B. Appropriate $242,000 from the Proposition C fund to fully fund the project;
  and
  C. Find this item is exempt from environmental review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA).
8.  UPDATE  ON  THE  CLAREMONT TEMPORARY HOUSING STABILIZATION AND
  RELOCATION PROGRAM (FUNDING SOURCE: GENERAL FUND AND AMERICAN
  RESCUE PLAN ACT FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council:
  A. Approve the revised Program Guidelines; and
  B. Appropriate $680,000 of the $3.4 million in proceeds from the sale of the
  451 W. Arrow Highway property, bringing the program budget to $1,680,000
  in total.
  Attachment(s):  Revised Program Guidelines

PUBLIC HEARINGS - None

ORDINANCES - None

ADMINISTRATIVE ITEMS
9.  APPROVAL OF THE 2024-26 CITY COUNCIL PRIORITIES AND OBJECTIVES (FUNDING
  SOURCES: VARIOUS)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the  City  Council  approve  the  2024-26 City  Council
  Priorities and Objectives.
  Attachment(s):  Proposed 2024-26 Council Priorities and Objectives
 Page 5  City Council Agenda  April 23, 2024

10. OAK PARK CEMETERY EXPANSION - PHASE 3 CONCEPTUAL  DESIGN  (FUNDING
  SOURCES: CEMETERY FUND AND MEASURE W FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council:
  A. Approve the conceptual design for the Phase 3 Oak Park Cemetery
  Expansion Project;
  B. Authorize the City Manager to execute a professional services agreement
  with RJM Design Group in the amount of $85,650 to prepare construction
  plans for bidding the Phase 3 Oak Park Cemetery Expansion Project;
  C. Appropriate $70,350 from the Cemetery Fund and $15,300 from the
  Measure W Fund to cover the cost to prepare plans and specifications; and
  D. Find this item is exempt from environmental review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA).
  Attachment(s):  Oak Park Cemetery Conceptual Design
  Oak Park Cemetery Restroom Design
  Friends of Oak Park Cemetery Letter of Support
  Excerpt from the Draft 04-03-24 CHS Commission Minutes

CONTINUED PUBLIC COMMENT
This time is reserved for those persons who were unable to speak earlier in the agenda because
of the 30-minute time restriction.

COMMISSIONS/COMMITTEES

  One Police Commission Vacancy
  One Traffic and Transportation Commission Vacancy
  Two Sustainability Committee Vacancies
  One Public Art Committee Vacancy

ADJOURNMENT

THE NEXT REGULAR MEETING OF THE CLAREMONT CITY COUNCIL WILL BE HELD ON,
MAY 14, 2024, AT 6:30 PM, IN THE CLAREMONT COUNCIL CHAMBER, 225 WEST SECOND
STREET, CLAREMONT, CA 91711.

A LOOK AHEAD – Upcoming Meetings and Tentative Agenda Items

- Recognition of Claremont Stars Boys 2012 Soccer Club SOCAL State Cup Elite CupChampions
- Claremont Police Foundation LifeVac Presentation
- Resolution Approving City Warrant Register Dated April 25, 2024
- Approval of City Council Meeting Minutes of April 23, 2024
- Resolution Accepting Engineer's Landscape and Lighting District Annual Report
  and Setting Public Hearing Date for June 11, 2024
- Sanitation and Sewer Rate Increase Based on Consumer Price Index Increase
 Page 6  City Council Agenda  April 23, 2024

BE MADE AVAILABLE IN APPROPRIATE ALTERNATIVE FORMATS TO PERSONS WITH
DISABILITIES. ANY PERSON WITH A DISABILITY WHO REQUIRES A MODIFICATION OR
ACCOMMODATION IN ORDER TO PARTICIPATE IN A CITY MEETING SHOULD CONTACT THE
CITY CLERK AT 909-399-5461 “VOICE” OR 1-800-735-2929 “TT/TTY” AT LEAST THREE (3)

I, SHELLEY DESAUTELS, CITY CLERK OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, HEREBY
